steps.content: The metal device pulses with faint light, establishing a defensive line that shields against the Mania.

The hurricane howls around them. Horo can't make out what the strangers are shouting, but she can see their hand gestures. They're signaling for the Legion's vehicle to follow them, but... they seem to be heading deeper into the storm.
Horo grits her teeth and stamps her foot, then slams down on the accelerator to follow them, trailing the small sand boat into a narrow crevice at the base of the rock face.
[Background: Underground Tunnel]
As they enter the tunnel, the storm finally stops.
The raging black sand cannot reach inside this tunnel. The passage stretches deep into darkness, mysterious and chilly.
...But regardless, the storm has stopped. Only now can Horo spare the energy to check on the wounded on board.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Where's Hella? How is she?

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: Her injuries aren't serious, but she hasn't regained consciousness yet. She'll probably need a bit more time to come around.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Alright. What about the others?
In truth, everyone has sustained injuries to varying degrees. But the wounded simply wave their hands dismissively, indicating they are fine.

In the distance, the sand boat gradually comes to a stop. The black-robed figures onboard huddle together, muttering unintelligibly among themselves. They repeatedly glance toward the Legion's vehicle, yet cautiously avoid approaching immediately.
[Flashback][Background: WhiteSands Storm]

This mysterious group isn't made up of fighters. Their combat abilities and tactical awareness are only average, but that strange metal device of theirs can resist Mania almost as well as Hypercubes do.
Furthermore, that black magnetic sandstorm out there was also extremely unusual.
Unlike any sandstorm the Legion had previously encountered, it didn't simply sweep in one direction, but seemed to have locked onto the Legion, pursuing them relentlessly.
...Could this extraordinary phenomenon be connected to the <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color>?
[Flashback][Background: WhiteSands Market]

This photograph was recovered from the wreckage of a WhiteSands merchant caravan. The place was already wrecked when the Legion arrived. Horo discovered a bloodstained envelope hidden in a secret compartment among the cargo, which contained this photograph.
The origin of the inheritance picture was still unknown, so the Legion could only follow the caravan's trail, hoping to trace its source...
Eventually, their destination pointed to the outskirts of Fraser, a small settlement so obscure it wasn't even marked on any maps.
[Background: Underground Tunnel]
...Perhaps what she's been searching for all this time is right here.

Meanwhile, the robed figures seem to have finished their discussion, and one of them approaches the Legion's vehicle. He speaks at length, but Horo can't understand a single word. It's the dialect of a foreign race from WhiteSands.
The leader frowns and says a few more sentences. He points at the unconscious Hella in the vehicle, his tone becoming serious as murmurs of agitation spread through the crowd behind him.

Horo shifts slightly to shield Hella from view. Outland groups in WhiteSands don't all share the same attitude toward DisCity. Before any formal negotiations, she needs to determine where these people stand, and then...
[Transition for 1s, subtle sound effect of Hella waking up]
A weak groan comes from behind. Horo immediately senses trouble, but by the time she turns around, it's already too late.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oww, my head's spinning... Where the heck did that storm blow us to...?
Hella groggily pulls herself up, only to find herself caught between two groups staring at her with completely different expressions.
Horo's face contorts in dismay, while the young man's expression darkens the instant he hears the Disian words, and he immediately grabs his weapon.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh no, don't tell me I've messed up again...?
The robed figures erupt into chaos, shouting in their unintelligible language as they charge forward.

steps.speaker: Leading Youth
steps.content: You're from DisCity! Spies! Take this!
Some hotheads in the Legion try to rise to their feet, but Horo forcefully holds them down.

The situation is still unclear. The inheritance is missing, and we still need to investigate their new weapons. This isn't the time for conflict. We can't all be captured—at least one of us needs to remain free...
...Someone who can infiltrate the enemy camp and gain their acceptance.
With a swift motion, Horo grabs Hella and shoves her off the vehicle, sending her tumbling directly into the group of robed figures behind.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Useless trash! Always running your mouth and ruining our plans! Should've sold you to DisCity a long time ago!
Their eyes meet, and Hella immediately understands Horo's plan.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You, ugh, shut it, you filthy human trafficker! She forced me into all this! Please help me...
After a chaotic struggle, the robed figures finally subdues the Legion.

They search through everything in the vehicle, not sparing even the Legionnaires' personal belongings. Finding no concrete evidence of espionage, the young man eyes them suspiciously before finally waving his hand, ordering them to be detained for the time being.
As for Hella, who rebelled against her companions...

The leading young man approaches Hella and speaks, but the stream of unintelligible sounds only results in a bewildered expression on Hella's face. Scratching his head, the youth opens his mouth again, now speaking in Disian with a peculiar accent.

steps.speaker: Leading Youth
steps.content: My words, do you understand? Are you with them?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No no no! I, I was kidnapped by them! Absolutely not with them! They, bad! Me, good!
The youth translates Hella's words to his companions, triggering another wave of collective outrage.

steps.speaker: Leading Youth
steps.content: So, they tricked you into coming with them... Do you know where your home is? Do you have somewhere to go back to?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Uh, a-am I supposed to have one...?
Hella steals a glance at Horo, who shakes her head in response.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...No, I don't anymore! They were planning to sell me to some unknown town real far away. I don't remember the way back. Even if I wanted to return, I couldn't anymore...
After hearing this, the youth glares at the Legionnaires with righteous fury, then pulls Hella protectively to his side.

steps.speaker: Leading Youth
steps.content: Hmph, bastards from DisCity! Don't worry, you're safe now.

steps.speaker: Leading Youth
steps.content: Come on! You can come home with us!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha, haha... Thank you all so much...
The suspicious spies get tied up while Hella, the damsel in distress, receives an enthusiastic welcome as they escort her deeper into the passage.
She looks back discreetly, making eye contact with her crew. Though her eyes are filled with panic, she still manages to give them a stiff thumbs up while silently mouthing some words.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...D-don't worry, I'll definitely find a way to rescue you all!
As they continue forward, the bright spot at the tunnel's end keeps growing in size. Emerging suddenly from the darkness, Hella's eyes can barely stay open against the piercing brightness...
[White screen transition]
When Hella opens her eyes, the first things she sees are beams of light cascading from above, and at the edge of her vision, a figure with an overwhelming presence.
[CG - Figure by the Window A]
From above, a figure stands bathed in radiance. Her silhouette is swallowed by the blinding light, making her appear hazy.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmm...?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Someone's standing by the window. Who is it...?
From a distance, Hella seems to lock eyes with the figure. She can't make out her face, only catching glimpses of flowing robes and long golden hair cascading down her back.
The figure by the window appears to notice Hella too. She turns her head, seemingly about to say something to Hella.
But her voice is still blurred out by the distance, dissolving into the light.
After another blink, the figure by the window has vanished. Hella rubs her eyes vigorously, and the dizziness finally subsides as her vision returns to normal.
And before her stretches a scene entirely different from what she witnessed moments ago.
